title: Book Two · Chapter 165: The Last Practice
story:
Ronan knows the number before he sits down. He has three good independent results. The sixth practice must give him one more.

The page is about a packet with a missing card. Students must read the instructions and explain the next step. No one needs to find the card. They need to give the visitor a useful answer.

Ronan reads carefully. The packet has two sheets and a blue card. A visitor gets a packet at the front desk. If the card is missing, the visitor must take the packet to the teacher at the return desk.

He writes the number of sheets. He writes the colour of the card. He is sure those two answers are right.

When Miss Wu comes, she holds an empty packet.

“My blue card is missing,” she says. “What do I do?”

“Go to the front desk.”

The answer comes quickly. Too quickly. He remembers the front desk from the first instruction.

“Show me the line,” she says.

He finds the line about getting a packet. Then he sees the missing-card instruction below it.

“The return desk,” he says. “I gave you the wrong desk.”

Miss Wu lets him explain again. He points to the correct line. She marks the first answer and the correction separately.

Ronan looks at her pencil.

“Does the correction count?”

“Your first answer needs to give the right next step. We use the same rule for everyone. You needed my question before you found the right line. This result cannot count.”

“But I found it.”

“Yes. After I asked you to check. Keep that correction. It helps your practice.”

He nods. His mouth feels dry. The last chance is over, and the right answer is on his paper too late.

At the end, Miss Wu collects the six original practice pages from each student. She will put their results on one record.

Students with at least four good results without help can take the final tasks. Their names will go on the shortlist. Ronan takes the fourth page from its folded place and adds it to his pile.

The teacher tells everyone to check the new record next week. They must tell her about any mistakes. Then she can correct the record before she finishes the shortlist.

Ronan walks home alone. Near the green door, he sees Mum carry a basket with both hands. He takes one side. He says nothing.

“A hard afternoon?” she asks.

“I missed the last task.”

They put the basket on the kitchen floor. Mum gives him water and waits.

He tells her about the two desks. She listens until he finishes.

“I wanted that place,” he says.

“I know.”

She sits beside him. For a while, they watch light move across the opposite wall. Then she asks him to stay for tea before he starts his other work, and he stays.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

missing＝缺少的；correction＝更正；shortlist＝最终候选名单；next step＝下一步。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan最后一次练习的关键错误是什么？
2. 六次练习结束后，他实际上有几次独立合格结果？

## 读句子

**She marks the first answer and the correction separately.**

拆开看：She / marks / the first answer and the correction separately.

她／分别标记／最初答案和更正。
